notes: Forum trade offers and the pizza offer (decisions.md 2026-10-16). Read by sim/offers.gd. Accepting an offer spends BTC on goods the player would have bought anyway, so it saves that much cash; the regret counter tracks what the coins are worth later.

mean_days_between_offers.note: Offers arrive at random once the player mines and BTC has a price.

offer_value_usd.note: Goods on offer (a pizza, a used graphics card, a T-shirt), priced in BTC at that day's close.

offer_expiry_days.note: An offer not taken in this many days lapses.

pizza_btc.note: The pizza_day trade: 10,000 BTC for two pizzas. Offered only to a player holding that much.

pizza_value_usd.note: Cash the two pizzas save the player.
